conclusion: When supplementing an existing organic base beneath a generic interface with an independent output Z plan, use the same layer index and compare the actual base top Z with the interface bottom Z. Using the preceding index can reject every layer even though the matching base exists. Preserve the original generic-interface and contact paths, supplement only collision-clipped missing base areas whose closed component reaches both the existing base and the generic region, and do not claim complete bearing when other components remain detached.
